about.heading: Skills, tools & passions
about.sub: A blend of technical backend expertise and creative hobbies.
about.bio_text:
Currently based in the south of France, I'm a Partnership Manager and Developer at Apimo, a leading PropTech CRM platform. Overseeing the entire integration lifecycle for our partner ecosystem, I collaborate with real estate portals, service providers, and AI companies while continuing to drive full-stack development, API design, and technical specification.

Having built my foundation here as a web developer, I've contributed tens of thousands of commits and millions of lines of code—a technical core that allows me to bridge the gap between engineering and strategic business growth.

I'm inherently curious and always eager to try new things, a mindset rooted in my multicultural background, which also made speaking multiple languages second nature. Off-screen, that love for discovery shows up in my interest in travel, local food scenes, new technologies, design, and my work with generative AI art.
about.skill.api_desc: Over 60+ API integrations these last years
about.skill.javascript_desc: I know enough JS to get by, but not enough to be dangerous

about.skill.travel_desc: Culture, nature, but mainly for the food and coffee

timeline.heading: Work & Personal Journey
timeline.sub: A quick look at what I have been up to these last few years.
timeline.event_some_stuff_desc: Grew up mainly in France and Malaysia, studied Network and Telecommunications @ the University of Sophia-Antipolis in the South of France and got my Bachelor's degree in 2014.
timeline.event_apimo_dev_desc: Joined Apimo as a Web Developer building real estate CRM applications, core backend services in PHP Symfony/MySQL, and property synchronization feeds.
timeline.event_apimo_project_manager_desc: Stepped up to manage white-label projects for key local and international accounts—handling onboarding, technical consulting, and leading developers to ship custom client solutions.
timeline.event_ppw_bangkok_desc: Attended Property Portal Watch in Bangkok (my first professional event!), connecting with real estate C-level executives and founders. Went on to represent Apimo at key industry events, including RENT in Paris and PPW in Madrid.
timeline.event_apimo_partnership_desc: Transitioned to leading technical partnerships at Apimo while remaining hands-on in code, architecting integration lifecycles, API partner ecosystems, and strategic collaborations.
timeline.event_skydiving_desc: Took the leap. Crossed off a major personal bucket-list item (which I will do again, for sure).
timeline.event_ai_art_desc: After discovering AI art in 2022, I dived deeper into generative AI visual models and diffusion algorithms, launching @Shaun.AI as a dedicated creative outlet for experimental digital art
timeline.event_gen48_desc: Competed in Runway's 48-hour AI short film contest, creating 'Burning Canyons' from concept, script, and storyboard to final AI generation and edit in a single weekend. Later the same year, I would also enter a similar contest by ElevenLabs and PikaLabs with 'Beyond Dreams'.
timeline.event_banque_postale_desc: Shaun.AI was commissioned by La Banque Postale to create artwork for their I.Artistes Challenge, which I won via public vote. Later on, I worked on a FOOH (Fake Out Of Home) online campaign for them, which was featured on Brut and other media outlets.
timeline.event_personal_portfolio_desc: Decided to build my own website after many years of thinking about it (and also lacking time). With AI and the tools surrounding it, the process has been much easier and very interesting. On top of the speed of development, I'm able to learn and experiment with modern technologies and UI/UX features.
